reached_sql:
with common_joins as (
    select date_dim.d_date_sk, store_sales.ss_customer_sk, customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name
    from store_sales
    join date_dim on store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk and d_month_seq between 1189 and 1189 + 11
    join customer on store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    union all
    select date_dim.d_date_sk, catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk, customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name
    from catalog_sales
    join date_dim on catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk and d_month_seq between 1189 and 1189 + 11
    join customer on catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    union all
    select date_dim.d_date_sk, web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk, customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name
    from web_sales
    join date_dim on web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk and d_month_seq between 1189 and 1189 + 11
    join customer on web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
)
select count(*) from common_joins limit 100
